title: Evaluation of a list of Tseitin constraints
statement: Let $a$ assign a Boolean value to each natural-numbered vertex, let $z$ be a natural number, and let $gs$ be a finite list of gates. The conjunction of all clauses in the Tseitin encodings of these gates, with the $i$th gate encoded at vertex $z+i$, evaluates to true under $a$ if and only if each gate's Tseitin encoding at its corresponding vertex evaluates to true.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean assignment to natural-numbered vertices
